projectDescription:
Study space capacity tool 

A platform or tool that can help you in advance know if a library or building on the U of M (Michigan) campus is at capacity in terms of seats or bigger group tables. 

Students are the main user of this app. 

As the user, I’d like to be able to use this on my phone. For example, if I’m finishing up a class and thinking about where to go study, I want to be able to check if there are available desks or seats and whether it’s busy or free (e.g. Ross, libraries).

For University of Michigan students so branding should be blue and yellow and you will need a Michigan login to access. 

Make it very easy to read and see if something is unavailable. If possible, unavailable shows up in a color like red and available is green so you can at a glance see it on the go. 

If possible, it’d be great to have a map of the campus that shows a heat map with green versus red. 

It might also be good to have a personalized quiz and ability to save “favorite” study spots e.g. places you go regularly. 

There should be the ability to indicate preferences (e.g. do I want sunlight/windows, an outlet). 

I want to have the ability to filter study spots.

Showing building hours and having warnings on if they’re closing soon.

Show what’s nearby a study spot on campus (e.g. food places). 

In preferences, be able to indicate if you are studying individually (need a desk) or with a group (need a table? Do I need a light board?)

Have layouts of where your table is and different floor plans if possible.
